Score AP-MS interactions with SAINTexpress

Source: R/run_saint.R
run_saint.Rd

Runs the pure-R SAINTexpress engine: the spectral-count model (SAINTexpress-spc) for mode = "spc", the intensity model (SAINTexpress-int) for mode = "int". Both agree with native SAINTexpress 3.6.3 up to small numerical differences; the package tests compare them on the TIP49 data in inst/extdata/tip49.

Usage

run_saint(
  si,
  mode = c("spc", "int"),
  optimizer = c("base", "nloptr"),
  R = 100L,
  L = 100L,
  p2p_mapping = NULL
)

Arguments

si

A named list with the data frames inter, prey and bait, in any order. See the section "Input tables".

mode

"spc" for spectral counts, "int" for intensities.

optimizer

Optimizer for the model parameters (beta1, gamma): "base" (default) uses stats::optim() with method "L-BFGS-B"; "nloptr" uses NLopt COBYLA, as native SAINTexpress does, and needs the nloptr package. Both give nearly identical scores.

R

Integer >= 1, default 100. The most replicates averaged into AvgP: for a bait with more than R replicates, AvgP is the mean of the R highest replicate probabilities. Native option -R.

L

Integer >= 1, default 100. Spectral counts only: the number of control IPs, taken in decreasing order of the prey's count, used to estimate the prey's background (false-interaction) distribution. Native option -L. Checked but not used for mode = "int", as in native SAINTexpress-int.

p2p_mapping

NULL (default) or a list of known prey-prey interactions, used as a prior that boosts the scores of preys whose partners are also detected with the bait. The list has one element per row of si$prey, in the same order; element i is an integer vector with the row numbers of the preys linked to prey i (integer(0) for none). It plays the role of the optional fourth input file of native SAINTexpress (for example GO complexes). With NULL, TopoAvgP and TopoMaxP equal AvgP and MaxP.

Value

A data frame with one row per bait-prey pair, with the columns of the native SAINTexpress list.txt:

ColumnContent
Bait, Prey, PreyGeneBait, prey and prey gene name
Spec / IntensityPrey value per replicate IP, joined by vertical bars (int: normalised, . = absent)
SpecSum / IntensitySumSum over the replicates
AvgSpec / AvgIntensityMean over the replicates
NumReplicatesNumber of replicate IPs of the bait
ctrlCounts / ctrlIntensityPrey value per control IP, joined by vertical bars
AvgPProbability of a true interaction, averaged over the top R replicates
MaxPHighest replicate probability
TopoAvgP, TopoMaxPAvgP and MaxP with the p2p_mapping prior
SaintScoremax(AvgP, TopoAvgP)
logOddsScore / OddsScoreLowest replicate log odds of true vs false interaction
FoldChangeMean over the replicates divided by the control (background) mean
BFDRBayesian false discovery rate of the pair, from AvgP
boosted_byLinked preys from p2p_mapping that support the pair, joined by vertical bars

Names before the slash are for mode = "spc", after it for "int".

Input tables

Columns are matched by name when all required names are present; otherwise by position, in the order listed (as in the headerless native input files). A column that already carries a required name must then be at that name's position. Further columns are ignored.

inter, one row per prey detected in an IP (purification):

ColumnTypeContent
ipIdcharacterIP identifier, as in bait$ipId
baitIdcharacterBait of the IP, as in bait$baitId
preyIdcharacterPrey identifier, as in prey$preyId
quantnumericSpectral count, >= 0 ("spc"), or intensity, > 0 ("int")

prey, one row per prey:

ColumnTypeContent
preyIdcharacterUnique prey identifier
preyLengthnumericProtein length (optional, not used in scoring)
preyGeneIdcharacterGene name, reported as PreyGene (optional, defaults to preyId)

The prey table is matched by name when it has both preyId and preyGeneId. Otherwise the first column is preyId; with two columns the second is preyLength if numeric, else preyGeneId; with three or more, the second is preyLength and the third preyGeneId.

bait, one row per IP:

ColumnTypeContent
ipIdcharacterUnique IP identifier
baitIdcharacterBait name; replicate IPs share it
CorTcharacter"T" for a test IP, "C" for a negative control

Every inter$ipId must be in bait, every inter$preyId in prey, and inter$baitId must agree with bait. At least one test and one control IP are needed.

References

Teo G, Liu G, Zhang J, Nesvizhskii AI, Gingras AC, Choi H (2014). SAINTexpress: Improvements and additional features in Significance Analysis of INTeractome software. Journal of Proteomics, 100, 37-43. doi:10.1016/j.jprot.2013.10.023

See also

validate_saint_input()

Examples

si <- list(
  inter = data.frame(
    ipId = c("IP1", "IP1", "IP2", "IP2", "IP3", "IP4"),
    baitId = c("BaitA", "BaitA", "BaitA", "BaitA", "Ctrl", "Ctrl"),
    preyId = c("Prey1", "Prey2", "Prey1", "Prey2", "Prey1", "Prey2"),
    quant = c(20, 1, 18, 1, 1, 1)
  ),
  prey = data.frame(
    preyId = c("Prey1", "Prey2"),
    preyLength = c(500, 500),
    preyGeneId = c("Gene1", "Gene2")
  ),
  bait = data.frame(
    ipId = c("IP1", "IP2", "IP3", "IP4"),
    baitId = c("BaitA", "BaitA", "Ctrl", "Ctrl"),
    CorT = c("T", "T", "C", "C")
  )
)
run_saint(si, mode = "spc")
#>    Bait  Prey PreyGene  Spec SpecSum AvgSpec NumReplicates ctrlCounts AvgP MaxP
#> 1 BaitA Prey1    Gene1 20|18      38      19             2        1|0    1    1
#> 2 BaitA Prey2    Gene2   1|1       2       1             2        0|1    0    0
#>   TopoAvgP TopoMaxP SaintScore logOddsScore FoldChange BFDR boosted_by
#> 1        1        1          1        24.22         38    0           
#> 2        0        0          0        -0.19          2    0           

# Prey1 and Prey2 are known to interact
run_saint(si, mode = "spc", p2p_mapping = list(2L, 1L))
#>    Bait  Prey PreyGene  Spec SpecSum AvgSpec NumReplicates ctrlCounts AvgP MaxP
#> 1 BaitA Prey1    Gene1 20|18      38      19             2        1|0    1    1
#> 2 BaitA Prey2    Gene2   1|1       2       1             2        0|1    0    0
#>   TopoAvgP TopoMaxP SaintScore logOddsScore FoldChange BFDR boosted_by
#> 1        1        1          1        24.22         38    0           
#> 2        0        0          0        -0.19          2    0     Prey1|
